subject.title: fix(ui): persist Control UI settings across reconnects via gateway-owned LWW prefs writes

question: Should OpenClaw permanently permit hash-free, leaf-only last-writer-wins `config.patch` writes for persisted `ui.prefs`, with strict document CAS retained for every other configuration path?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive gateway configuration contract change rather than a purely internal browser repair; maintainers must decide whether the scoped concurrency exception is the intended durable product policy.

options.title: Accept the scoped LWW contract
options.body: After the PR is rebased and supplies inspectable live proof, accept leaf-only `ui.prefs` updates as the documented exception to document-wide CAS.

options.title: Keep universal document CAS
options.body: Reject the gateway exception and request a client or API design that preserves strict CAS for all persisted configuration writes.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped LWW contract
recommendation.body: After the PR is rebased and supplies inspectable live proof, accept leaf-only `ui.prefs` updates as the documented exception to document-wide CAS.

likelyOwner.reason: The submitted design and its predecessor context identify this author as the clearest available routing point for explaining or narrowing the proposed gateway/UI contract.
